title: •Leia’s Sporting Blaster
caption: •Leia’s Sporting Blaster (V)
game_text: Deploy on Leia or your non-droid Undercover spy. May target a character or creature for free. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny > defense value. During opponent’s move phase, if on your Undercover spy, may ‘break cover’ to fire.
lore: Defender sporting blaster, made by Drearian Defense Conglomerate. Intended for personal defense or small-game hunting. Short range. Low power. Carries energy for 50 shots.

notes: Title apostrophe is curly on the slip (Leia’s); wiki page title uses a straight one. Base: Premiere (empty expansion ring), copyright 1995 read off the 745 px scan. Wiki default page is the Glossary 2.0 errata text; printed face is 'Leia's Sporting Blaster (Original)' (also downloaded: Premiere-L-leiassportingblaster-decipher-archive.gif, 350 px) — lore identical. No modern 'Virtual Set N' remake; the only PC remake is Virtual Block 1 (VB1-…-pre.gif, 350 px preview), downloaded as modern. ‘break cover’ in single curly quotes on the slip.
